title: A Day at the Park
text:
Ben goes to the playground with his dad. It is warm and sunny in summer. Ben likes the slide and the sandbox.

In autumn, the trees are orange and brown. Ben and his dad collect leaves. In winter, they make a snowman at the playground.

questions.text: Who goes to the playground with Ben?
What do Ben and his dad do in autumn?
Why does Ben probably go to the playground in summer?
options: Because the weather is warm and sunny

questions.text: How does Ben probably feel about the playground?
options: He does not want to go there

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area where children play
a box filled with sand where young children play
the season between summer and winter
a figure made of snow, with a round body and head

paragraph_translations: Ben idzie na plac zabaw z tatą. Latem jest ciepło i słonecznie. Ben lubi zjeżdżalnię i piaskownicę.
Jesienią drzewa są pomarańczowe i brązowe. Ben i tata zbierają liście. Zimą robią na placu zabaw bałwana.
